comment: Very nice teacher, was very forgiving grader. Would recommend.

Snaza is the best!
He is so so brilliant and clear.
Unpretentious man: you will learn a lot!!

Dr. Snaza is one of the BEST professors you can have in your first year. If you're not sure where to start, start with him. Class is reading heavy but you can get away with not reading a couple of things. Basically, the class is discussion based (literally just talking about the reading) but in a very detailed way.

Dr. Snaza is the greatest professor. His FYS is very engaging and you learn so much from him during your time in this class. I highly recommend taking him for whatever class is available. He is the BEST!

We were talking about Nathan the other day am he is the best of the best 
Unpretentious, brilliant and a real community builder 10/10

Dr. Snaza is a brilliant professor but is not super personal with students (i.e. name learning). WGSS200 is a great course if you are looking to satisfy a gen-ed. The class is discussion heavy, and the required reading can be dense. The course only has a couple major written assignments but you have to do decently well on them to get a good grade.

Best teacher that I've had at Richmond and probably ever will have. He really cares and wants the best for each of his students, and is always there to talk if needed (about anything). His class discussions were always super interesting and engaging, and I learned so much in my time with him. If you have the chance to take class with him, do it!!!

The reading was definitely not easy, but the class is completely discussion based and he was EXTREMELY understanding with extensions, missed class, and off cameras. I loved this class and he made every class interesting. He even cut back requirements because we were stressed. A really amazing professor

Dr. Snaza is the smartest prof. ever. Every class is pretty socratic style, with people saying things that popped out to them in the reading and him building off of it. He doesn't believe in tests, lets you redo everything you turn in, leaves great notes, and is flexible. There is a lot of hard reading, but he explains everything and truly cares.

Professor Snaza is absolutely fantastic. He is completely understanding and grants extensions easily if you have a good reason to request one. There is a fair amount of reading but you can get away with not doing sometimes (he likes you if you participate often). Grading is tough but he gives great feedback and allows for re-writes.
I took Dr. Snaza for my FYS and he was really passionate about the topic. His class is a lot of readings and 3 essays, but he allows rewrites and gives good feedback.

Professor Snaza is an extremely caring professor. His main goal is to actually teach and prepare his students for the future rather than focusing on grades. He is very passionate about his work and is super knowledgeable about the topics he teaches.

I took Dr. Snaza's FYS Politics of Sexual Education class and it was super interesting. He is the type of professor that really just wants you to think. Because of that, he will let you rewrite ANYTHING you are graded on. He's super funny, insanely smart, and a great person to get to know on campus. Would definitely recommend taking his FYS.

Dr. Snaza is very engaging and laid-back. In his vampires class, he assigns books but pretty much feeds everything you could possibly need to know to do well. VERY few grades: two 5-page essays + a group talk; NO participation grade. Every class was so much fun, and it never seemed unreasonable. Honestly can't recommend him enough! He's awesome!

Nathan is the best professor I've ever taken at UR! He's super down to earth and really believes in the subject content of the course! He's super flexible as well. There are no hard deadlines, and he allows students to resubmit assignments. The course is reading heavy but it really adds to the discussion and content of the course! Simply Amazing!

He is literally my favorite professor here! He is very understanding and lenient and willing to work with you! He is very passionate and facilitated amazing discussions that make you think deeply and critically about things you may have never even thought about! Definitely take a class with him at UR!
He's a good professor. He's peculiar but he's funny.
Fair grader, nice guy, but never bothered to learn my name. Kind of discouraging when the class is so small.

Snaza is extremely passionate and intelligent. He consistently kept our class engaged and is a great facilitator of discussion. There is a lot of group work and you have to put effort into your grade, but it is worth it because you learn a lot. He is good about keeping his office hours and genuinely wants to see his students succeed.
An amazing professor and even better person. So interesting. He made me think about things I would have never considered. Loved him and his class.

Snaza is not only one of the most intelligent people I have ever met, but he is also one of the most understanding and compassionate teachers I have ever had.  His class is always interesting, and he keeps the discussion moving and actually gets the class to participate. His grading is no tougher than any other english teacher but he helps a lot

Knew nothing of this guy and took as gen ed requirement. I was pleasantly surprised and liked Snaza.  He was great at facilitating discussions and offered great positive feedback on papers. A few of the books were terrible, but that’s personal preference.  For non-English person, an A is tough, but a B is doable. All in all, Snaza’s a good guy
LOVE him! He's so smart and interesting. Approaches literature in a way I've never been taught before. Take him rather than take the class- you will not regret it!

Amazing professor! Makes it clear that he doesn't want his students worrying about grades and that this school focuses too much on them. He just wants you to understand and do the readings which are very interesting. TAKE HIM!
Handsome, smart, and friendly. Dr. Snaza is a wonderful professor. I wish I had more time with him. I recommend taking "him" rather than the class.
